<script>
    window.IsInDarkMode = false;
    let pianoWindows = [];
    let darkMode = localStorage.getItem("darkMode");
    function disableDarkMode() {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('darkmode');
        localStorage.setItem("darkMode", null);
        if (darkMode == null) darkMode = "lightmode";
        setPianoFramesThem("lightmode");
    }
    function enableDarkMode() {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('darkmode');
        localStorage.setItem("darkMode", "enabled");
        if (darkMode == null) darkMode = "darkMode";
        window.IsInDarkMode = true;
        setPianoFramesThem("darkmode");
    }
    function disableSystemDarkMode() {
        document.documentElement.classList.remove('darkmode');
        localStorage.setItem("darkMode", 'system-null');
        if (darkMode == null) darkMode = "system-null";
        setPianoFramesThem("lightmode");
    }
    function enableSystemDarkMode() {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('darkmode');
        localStorage.setItem("darkMode", "system-enable");
        if (darkMode == null) darkMode = "system-enable";
        window.IsInDarkMode = true;
        setPianoFramesThem("darkmode");
    }
    function setPianoFramesThem(theme) {
        if (pianoWindows.length > 0) {
            pianoWindows.forEach(w => {
                w.postMessage({
                    command: 'setDarkMode',
                    payload: { color_scheme: theme },
                }, '*');
            });
        }
    }

    if (darkMode === "enabled") {
        enableDarkMode();
    } else if (darkMode === 'null') {
        disableDarkMode();
    } else {
        if (window.matchMedia && (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches)) {
            enableSystemDarkMode();
        } else {
            disableSystemDarkMode();
        }
    }

    addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', (event) => {
        const darkmodeBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".btn--toggle-switch");
        // verifico se existe o botão. se sim, corremos o script. Útil para os embeds não correrem este código
        darkmodeBtns.forEach(el => {
            el.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const ourEmbeds = document.querySelectorAll('.story__callout--link .story__callout__wrapper > iframe');
                const pianoHpBlock = document.querySelector('#piano--hp-block iframe');
                if (document.documentElement.classList.contains("darkmode")) {
                    disableDarkMode();
                    // se estivermos nos artigos e houver embeds
                    if (document.body.classList.contains("v2020") && ourEmbeds.length > 0) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < ourEmbeds.length; i++) {
                            const iframeHtmlEl = ourEmbeds[i].contentWindow.document.getElementsByTagName("html")[0];
                            iframeHtmlEl.classList.remove("darkmode");
                        }
                    }
                    dataLayer.push({
                        event: "darkmode",
                        enable: false
                    });
                } else {
                    enableDarkMode();
                    // se estivermos nos artigos e houver embeds
                    if (document.body.classList.contains("v2020") && ourEmbeds.length > 0) {
                        for (let i = 0; i < ourEmbeds.length; i++) {
                            const iframeHtmlEl = ourEmbeds[i].contentWindow.document.getElementsByTagName("html")[0];
                            iframeHtmlEl.classList.add("darkmode");
                        }
                    }
                    dataLayer.push({
                        event: "darkmode",
                        enable: true
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    });

    var checkoutPianoWindow = [];

    var tp = window.tp || [];

    function getMbReference() {
        try {
            fetch("/api/piano/payment/get", {
                headers: {
                    "content-type": "application/json"
                },
                method: "post",
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify(window.conversion)
            }).then(response => {
                if (response.status == 200) {
                    response.json().then(data => {
                        checkoutPianoWindow.forEach(w => {
                            w.postMessage({
                                command: 'setMbReference',
                                payload: { data: data },
                            }, '*');
                        });
                        const checkTimer = window.isUpgrade ? startCheckTimerWithoutPaymentId : startCheckTimer;
                        window.checkPaymentInterval = setInterval(() => {
                                if (window.isUpgrade) {
                                    checkTimer();
                                } else {
                                    checkTimer(window.conversion.paymentId);
                                }
                            }, 15000);
                    });
                    return;
                }
            }).catch(err => {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    getMbReference();
                }, 1000);
            });
        } catch (e) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                getMbReference();
            }, 1000);
        }
    }

    function getMbWayPayment() {
        try {
            const booleanUpdateNumber = window.updateNumber === "true" ? true : false;
            window.conversion.phoneNumber = window.phoneNumber;
            window.conversion.updateNumber = booleanUpdateNumber;

            fetch("/api/piano/payment/get", {
                headers: {
                    "content-type": "application/json"
                },
                method: "post",
                credentials: "include",
                body: JSON.stringify(window.conversion)
            }).then(response => {
                if (response.status == 200) {
                    response.json().then(data => {
                        checkoutPianoWindow.forEach(w => {
                            w.postMessage({
                                command: 'setMbWayData',
                                payload: {
                                    data: data,
                                    phone: window.phoneNumber
                                },
                            }, '*');
                        });
                        const checkTimer = window.isUpgrade ? startCheckTimerWithoutPaymentId : startCheckTimer;
                        window.checkPaymentInterval = setInterval(() => {
                                if (window.isUpgrade) {
                                    checkTimer();
                                } else {
                                    checkTimer(window.conversion.paymentId);
                                }
                            }, 60000);
                    });
                    return;
                }
            }).catch(err => {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    //getMbWayPayment();
                    console.error("MBWay payment failed:", err);
                    window.mbwayPaymentStarted = false;
                }, 1000);
            });
        } catch (e) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                getMbWayPayment();
            }, 1000);
        }
    }

    function getLinkedTerm() {
        try {
            const url = `/api/piano/linkedterm/refund/eligibility`;
            fetch(url, {
                headers: {
                    "content-type": "application/json"
                },
                method: "GET",
                credentials: "include",
            }).then(response => {
                if (response.status == 200) {
                    response.json().then(data => {
                        checkoutPianoWindow.forEach(w => {
                            w.postMessage({
                                command: 'setLinkedTerm',
                                payload: { data: data },
                            }, '*');
                        });
                    });
                    return;
                }
            }).catch(err => {
                setTimeout(function () {
                    getLinkedTerm();
                }, 1000);
            });
        } catch (e) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                getLinkedTerm();
            }, 1000);
        }
    }

    function startCheckTimer(paymentId) {
        fetch("/api/piano/payment/check?paymentId=" + paymentId, {
            headers: {
                "content-type": "application/json"
            },
            method: "post",
            credentials: "include"
        }).then(response => {
            if (response.status == 200) {
                response.json().then(data => {
                    if (data.status == "paid" || window.finishPayment) {
                        checkoutPianoWindow[0].postMessage({
                            command: 'paymentReceived',
                            payload: { data: "" },
                        }, '*');
                        clearInterval(window.checkPaymentInterval);
                        refreshUser();
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
        });
    }

    function startCheckTimerWithoutPaymentId(){
        fetch("/api/piano/payment/checkUpgrade", {
            headers: {
                "content-type": "application/json"
            },
            method: "post",
            credentials: "include",
            body: JSON.stringify(window.conversion)
        }).then(response => {
            if (response.status == 200) {
                response.json().then(data => {
                    if (data.status == "paid" || window.finishPayment) {
                        checkoutPianoWindow[0].postMessage({
                            command: 'paymentReceived',
                            payload: { data: "" },
                        }, '*');
                        clearInterval(window.checkPaymentInterval);
                        refreshUser();
                    }
                });
                return;
            }
        });
    }

    function refreshUser() {
        fetch("/api/user/refresh", {
            method: "post",
            credentials: "include",
        }).then(response => {
            if (response.status === 200) {
                sessionStorage.removeItem("user_session");
            }
        });
    }
</script>

<script>
    "use strict";

    let inFlight = false;

    function escapeHtml(str = "") {
        return String(str)
            .replaceAll("&", "&")
            .replaceAll("<", "<")
            .replaceAll(">", ">")
            .replaceAll('"', """)
            .replaceAll("'", "'");
    }

    function formatDate(iso) {
        if (!iso) return "";
        const d = new Date(iso);
        if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return "";
        return d.toLocaleDateString("pt-PT", {
            year: "numeric",
            month: "2-digit",
            day: "2-digit"
        });
    }

    function safeUrl(url) {
        try {
            const u = new URL(url, window.location.href);
            if (u.protocol === "http:" || u.protocol === "https:") return u.toString();
        } catch (e) {}
        return "#";
    }

    function imageHasMinWidth(src, minWidth = 232) {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (!src) return resolve(false);
            const img = new Image();
            img.onload = () => resolve(img.naturalWidth >= minWidth);
            img.onerror = () => resolve(false);
            img.src = src;
        });
    }

    async function loadImobiliario() {
        if (inFlight) return;
        inFlight = true;

        const url = `https://static.publico.pt/s3/widgets/imobiliario/mixed.json?cb=${Date.now()}`;

        try {
            const res = await fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);

            const json = await res.json();
            const items = Array.isArray(json?.items) ? json.items : [];

            if (!items.length) return;

            await renderImobiliario(items);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("Failed to load imobiliario JSON:", err);
        } finally {
            inFlight = false;
        }
    }

    async function renderImobiliario(items) {
        const root = document.querySelector(".block--category-6");
        if (!root) {
            console.error("Element .block--category-6 not found");
            return;
        }

        const title = "Público Imobiliário";
        const description = "";

        const headerHtml = `
            <header class="block__header">
                <h1 class="block__title">${escapeHtml(title)}</h1>
                <p>${escapeHtml(description)}</p>
            </header>
        `;

        const positions = [
            { wrapClass: "cs--1 cn--4 md-r-bdr" },
            { wrapClass: "cs--5 cn--4 md-l-r-bdr" },
            { wrapClass: "cs--9 cn--4 md-l-r-bdr" },
            { wrapClass: "cs--13 cn--4 md-l-bdr" }
        ];

        const withMedia = items.slice(0, 4);
        const noMedia = items.slice(4, 6);

        const brandLogoImo = "https://static.publico.pt/hp-2022/img/logo--imobiliario.png";
        const brandLogoSup = "https://static.publico.pt/hp-2022/img/logo--supercasa.png";

        function getLogoData(item) {
            const source = String(item?.source || item?.partner || item?.brand || "").toLowerCase();
            const isSup = source.includes("supercasa") || source === "sup";

            return {
                logo: isSup ? brandLogoSup : brandLogoImo,
                logoAlt: isSup ? "Supercasa" : "PÚBLICO Imobiliário"
            };
        }

        const mediaCardsHtml = (await Promise.all(
            withMedia.map(async (item, idx) => {
                const pos = positions[idx] || positions[0];

                const href = safeUrl(item?.url || "#");
                const itemTitle = item?.title || "—";

                const imgRaw = item?.image?.url || "";
                const img = safeUrl(imgRaw);
                const imgAlt = item?.image?.title || itemTitle;

                const { logo, logoAlt } = getLogoData(item);

                const hasValidImage = img !== "#" && img ? await imageHasMinWidth(img, 232) : false;
                const toneClass = hasValidImage ? "tone--paid" : "tone--paid tone--opinion";

                // const date = formatDate(item?.last_published_at);
                // const dateHtml = date ? `<div class="article__meta">${escapeHtml(date)}</div>` : "";
                const dateHtml = "";

                return `
                    <div class="${pos.wrapClass}">
                        <article class="article ${toneClass} article--level-4 article--no-lead article--no-lead">
                            <div class="article__inner">

                                ${hasValidImage ? `
                                    <figure class="article__figure">
                                        <a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" class="flex-media" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
                                            <img src="${escapeHtml(img)}" width="500" alt="${escapeHtml(imgAlt)}" loading="lazy">
                                        </a>
                                    </figure>
                                ` : ""}

                                <div class="article__content">
                                    <h2 class="article__title">
                                        <a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(itemTitle)}</a>
                                    </h2>

                                    ${dateHtml}

                                    <div class="article__byline">
                                        <a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
                                            <img src="${escapeHtml(logo)}" width="66" alt="${escapeHtml(logoAlt)}" loading="lazy">
                                            <span class="branded-content-label">Conteúdo comercial</span>
                                        </a>
                                    </div>
                                </div>

                            </div>
                        </article>
                    </div>
                `;
            })
        )).join("");

        const noMediaHtml = noMedia.map((item, idx) => {
            const href = safeUrl(item?.url || "#");
            const itemTitle = item?.title || "—";
            const extraClass = idx === 1 ? " hide-bdr-btm" : "";

            const { logo, logoAlt } = getLogoData(item);

            return `
                <article class="article tone--paid article--level-4 article--no-media${extraClass}">
                    <div class="article__inner">
                        <div class="article__content">
                            <h2 class="article__title">
                                <a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escapeHtml(itemTitle)}</a>
                            </h2>
                            <div class="article__byline">
                                <a href="${escapeHtml(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
                                    <img src="${escapeHtml(logo)}" width="66" alt="${escapeHtml(logoAlt)}" loading="lazy">
                                    <span class="branded-content-label">Conteúdo comercial</span>
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </article>
            `;
        }).join("");

        root.innerHTML = `
            ${headerHtml}
            <div class="grid--v">
                ${mediaCardsHtml}
                <div class="cs--1 cn--16 md-t-bdr xlg-cs--17 xlg-cn--4 xlg-l-bdr ie-rs--2">
                    <div class="grid--flexible">
                        ${noMediaHtml}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    loadImobiliario();
    setInterval(loadImobiliario, 15 * 60 * 1000);
</script>

<script>
if (document.location.pathname.indexOf("/assinaturas/sub30") === 0

    &&  (userOnPage.userGuid || userOnPage.userId)) 
    {
        function getBirthDate() {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const listener = (event) => {
                    if (event.origin !== "https://sentinel.publico.pt")
                        return; if (!event.data || !event.data.result) {
                            reject(new Error("Erro, apresentar mensagem para tentar novamente"));
                            return;
                        } const data = event.data;
                    const birthDate = data.value.item1; resolve(birthDate); window.removeEventListener("message", listener);
                }; window.addEventListener("message", listener);
            });
        }
    
        getBirthDate()
            .then(birthDate => {
                updateBirthday((userOnPage.userGuid || userOnPage.userId), birthDate)
            })
            .catch(error => {
                console.log('Erro: ' + error.message);
            });

        async function updateBirthday(userId, birthDate) {
            const response = await fetch(
                `/utilizador/${userId}/updateBirthday`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json"
                    },
                    credentials: "include",
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        birthday: birthDate,
                        validateBirthday: true
                    })
                }
            );

            if (!response.ok) {
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    throw new Error("Não autorizado");
                }
                throw new Error("Erro");
            }
            window.location.reload();
            return true;
        }
    }
